python.fix: This project needs Python 3.11. Run `uv python install 3.11` and then `uv sync`.

uv.fix: Install uv (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) so `make` commands use the locked environment.

packages.fix: Run `make install` (or `uv sync`) to install the locked environment.

lock_missing.fix: Restore uv.lock from git: `git checkout uv.lock`.

lock_drift.fix: Your environment drifted from uv.lock. Run `make install` to restore exact versions.

fixtures_changed.fix: A fixture file was modified. Restore it with `git checkout data/fixtures` (or regenerate: `make fixtures`).

raw_cache_empty.see: ! WARN  real-data cache  empty (no Yahoo downloads yet)
raw_cache_empty.fix: Only needed for the real study: run `make fetch-data` (needs internet). Fixtures work offline.

raw_cache_changed.fix: A cached raw file changed or disappeared. Delete its manifest entry and re-run `make fetch-data`.

tsfm_missing.see: ! WARN  TSFM package torch  not installed
tsfm_missing.fix: Needed only for the foundation models: run `make install-tsfm` (downloads PyTorch, ~6 GB).

tsfm_broken.see: ✗ FAIL  TSFM package torch  import error: …
tsfm_broken.fix: The package is installed but broken. Run `make install-tsfm` again.

hub_missing.see: ! WARN  model weights  huggingface_hub not installed

weights_failed.see: ✗ FAIL  weights chronos_bolt_tiny  could not download … from Hugging Face
weights_failed.fix: Check your internet connection/proxy; the model will be reported UNAVAILABLE until this works.

weights_missing.see: ! WARN  weights chronos_bolt_tiny  … not downloaded yet
weights_missing.fix: They download automatically on the first `make reproduce`; or run `make doctor ONLINE=1` to fetch now.

notebooks_missing.fix: Run `make lessons` to rebuild them from lesson.py.

jupyter_missing.see: ! WARN  lessons  11 lessons; JupyterLab not installed
jupyter_missing.fix: To open the notebooks run `make install-all`, then `uv run jupyter lab`.
